title: Introduction to Chemistry - Chemistry - Branches of Chemistry
subject: Chemistry

questions.q: A chemist is studying a new carbon-based compound derived from a rainforest plant that might cure cancer. Which branch of chemistry does this primarily fall under?
questions.explain: Organic chemistry is primarily defined as the study of carbon-containing compounds, especially those relevant to living things.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: A forensic scientist analyzes a mysterious white powder to determine its exact chemical composition and the percentage of each element present. This is an application of __________.
questions.explain: Analytical chemistry focuses on the identification (qualitative) and quantification (quantitative) of the components of matter.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Which branch of chemistry focuses on the mechanism, rate, and energy transfer that occurs when matter undergoes a change?
questions.explain: Physical chemistry deals with the mechanism, rate, and energy transfer of chemical systems, bridging chemistry and physics.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: A researcher is developing a new catalyst for processing metal ores (minerals) that do not contain carbon. This field is best described as __________.
questions.explain: Inorganic chemistry generally covers the study of compounds that do not contain carbon, such as minerals, metals, and organometallic compounds.
questions.subject: Chemistry
